articles.txt:
La console Sony PS5 donne envie de lancer une partie, puis une autre, sans jamais s'ennuyer. Le disque SSD, un stockage bien plus rapide qu'un disque dur classique, rend les chargements des jeux PS5 installés quasi instantanés. L'écran de menu laisse donc très vite place à l'action, ce qui rend chaque relance de partie bien plus agréable. L'interface donne un accès immédiat à presque toutes les options du système sans quitter la partie, pour modifier un réglage tout en gardant le fil du jeu. Par ailleurs, le retour haptique de la manette DualSense reproduit des vibrations précises selon l'action à l'écran. Ses gâchettes adaptatives opposent une résistance variable pour ressentir l'impact des actions, sur une sélection de jeux PS5. Les acheteurs lui attribuent 4,7 sur 5, d'après 1 699 avis. La console Sony PS5 est au prix de 899,99 euros sur Amazon .
La compatibilité avec les jeux PS4 de cette console Sony PS5 donne accès à une ludothèque plus large que les seuls titres PS5. Le Ray Tracing simule le trajet de la lumière dans la scène, pour des reflets et des ombres plus proches de ce que l'œil perçoit en vrai. La prise en charge du HDR et de la 4K sur cette console Sony PS5 donne des couleurs vives et une image détaillée sur un écran compatible. Le HDR agrandit l'écart entre zones claires et sombres, et la 4K affiche bien plus de points qu'une image Full HD. La technologie Tempest 3D AudioTech place les bruits tout autour du joueur, pour situer plus facilement d'où vient chaque son. De plus, le port HDMI 2.1 relie la console au téléviseur par un seul câble, et le port Ethernet branche internet par câble pour jouer en ligne.

articles.t: Hameçonnage, virus : les arnaques derrière la sortie de GTA VI - ICI
articles.chapeau: La sortie de GTA VI s
articles.txt:
Des visuels de GTA VI sur un écran d'ordinateur et de smartphone © AFP - Nikolas Kokovlis et NurPhoto Valentin Bertrand Diffusé le lundi 23 novembre 2026 à 5h41
La sortie de GTA VI s'accompagne de nombreuses arnaques, surfant sur l'impatience des fans. Une "technique" permettant soi-disant d'obtenir le jeu gratuitement fait beaucoup parler d'elle.
Vous avez peut-être vu passer ce nom tout en haut de la liste au Père Noël : GTA VI. C'est LE jeu vidéo événement de cet automne et, forcément, les escrocs s'en donnent à cœur joie.
Sur Internet, au moins une tentative de hameçonnage sur dix est liée à la sortie de GTA VI. C'est le constat implacable dressé par une société américaine de formation en cybersécurité, KnowBe4. La société est arrivée à ce résultat après un scan du web, fin octobre.
Depuis la sortie mondiale, jeudi dernier, des nouvelles aventures de ce couple de gangsters – ces Bonnie and Clyde des temps modernes, prêts à tout pour échapper à la police –, les arnaques ne cessent de se propager. Sur les réseaux sociaux, les blogs, des vidéos et des posts racoleurs promettent une méthode détournée pour télécharger le jeu gratuitement.
Capture d'écran du prétendu guide de téléchargement - Avast Un prétendu "guide de téléchargement" circule. Il s'agit d'un document PDF d'apparence très professionnelle et épuré. Il présente, en son centre, un bouton "Télécharger maintenant" de redirection vers une page internet. En bas du document, un message faussement rassurant en anglais indique : "Vous arrivez sur le site d'un tiers, vérifiez la page avant de télécharger." Une alerte habile, conçue pour endormir la vigilance des internautes.
Pour le coup, les escrocs ont presque poussé l'honnêteté jusqu'au bout : cette mise en garde initiale dit vraie. Car le logiciel qui s'installe discrètement lorsque l'on clique n'a absolument rien à voir avec le jeu vidéo d'aventures. À la place, c'est un virus qui s'invite sur votre ordinateur. Ce logiciel espion aspire certaines données personnelles, comme l'a indiqué l'antivirus Avast. Ces informations volées peuvent être des identifiants ou des mots de passe. Autrement dit, des informations très sensibles.
Pour éviter la mésaventure, plusieurs indices doivent vous mettre la puce à l'oreille. Il y a d'abord cette gratuité suspecte : trouver gratuitement ce jeu (vendu 79,99 €) au moment de sa sortie doit éveiller la méfiance. Un indice plus subtil se cache aussi dans le guide de téléchargement. Il est question d'une version du jeu adaptée aux PC. Or, GTA VI n'existe, à ce jour, que sur consoles (PlayStation ou Xbox). N'importe quel lien annonçant une version pour ordinateur ou mobile est donc, forcément, une arnaque.
La meilleure façon de se procurer ce jeu en toute sécurité reste donc les boutiques officielles. Pour payer un peu moins cher, il est aussi recommandé de se tourner vers les sites de revente reconnus.
Vous avez été victime d'une arnaque ou repéré une fausse information ? Écrivez-nous à ici.arnaques@radiofrance.com.
VOTRE AVIS - En vue de l’élection présidentielle de 2027, ICI lance un grand cycle de consultations et propose tous les mois un questionnaire thématique afin de connaître les attentes des citoyens pour le ou la futur(e) président(e) de la République.
Les escroqueries par manipulation étaient en forte hausse en 2025, selon le dernier bilan en septembre par l'Observatoire de la sécurité des moyens de paiement (OSMP) de la Banque de France.
Sur les réseaux sociaux, attention aux recettes "miracles" pour se "blanchir" les dents De nombreuses vidéos à grand succès prétendent livrer aux internautes des recettes maison pour obtenir facilement des dents d'un blanc éclatant. Ces mélanges peuvent s'avérer dangereux pour l'émail et les gencives.

GTA 6 amplifies the need for more parental supervision | The National
articles.chapeau: The latest version mixes violence, sexual content and drug abuse
articles.txt:
The debate over the potential negative effects of video games on minors has persisted for decades, yet it has never been as intense or wide-ranging as it is today.
We have witnessed advances in technology that have widened the scale of youth online engagement, causing elevated concerns regarding their mental health and behavioural patterns.
With the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 last week, a fierce discussion has been, justifiably, initiated about the influence and impact that the game has on children.
It is no secret that the main themes of the franchise were controversial to begin with, apparent as they are in the name of the game. It essentially glorified criminals in their pursuit to steal vehicles, carry out robberies, make dirty money and evade or confront law enforcement.
The latest version of GTA comes with new problematic themes, as it mixes violence, sexual content, profanity, and drug and alcohol abuse. This goes far beyond the innocent wish of a youngster who wants to play a game.
The latest version of GTA mixes violence, sexual content, profanity, and drug and alcohol abuse The seriousness of the issue was highlighted in a direct and explicit warning issued by UAE’s Drug Enforcement Authority, which urged families to be vigilant and to monitor any exposure to drug-related content within the game.
The authority warned against “scenes involving drug use and illegal activities, and the possible negative effects these may have on the awareness and behaviour of children and young people”.
Further, the decision by the UAE’s National Media Authority to rate GTA 6 at “21+” is well-placed, particularly if we consider the aspects of the game that run counter the ethical and moral codes of most societies in the Middle East. The rating makes it clear that it is suitable only for those aged 21 and above – the highest rating that a computer game can be given. It is clearly unsuitable for individuals below that age, let alone for children.
Last week, the NDEA organised the World Police Summit in Dubai. The event focused specifically on emerging threats posed by narcotics and the latest policies put forward to prevent drug abuse, fight the trafficking and smuggling of illegal substances, and solidify international co-operation to protect societies. This is a welcome development.
The importance of parental supervision should be stressed. Adults must verify the content of video games before children are permitted to interact with them However, for these efforts to be fruitful, a serious discussion should take place concerning the content of such games, and the negative impact they could have on the awareness and behaviour of the most vulnerable members of any community.
While official steps are being taken and public forums are exploring the most adequate methods to go ahead, the importance of parental supervision should be stressed. Adults must lead the way in verifying the content of video games before children are permitted to interact with them.

articles.t: GTA VI Leak vs Launch: 99 Metacritic After 4 Years
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 leak comparison: GameRant says 2022 footage misled doubters, and launch scored 99 on Metacritic. See what holds up and what is opinion.
articles.txt:
Image: Rockstar Games Four years after unfinished footage escaped Rockstar Games, the finished product has landed, and the contrast is the story of the week. On November 22, 2026, GameRant published a GTA 6 leak comparison under the headline “Grand Theft Auto 6 Leak Comparison Shows You Should Never Doubt Rockstar.” Writer Ollie Tuscarny set early screenshots tied to the 2022 leak beside the game that shipped on November 19, 2026, and argued that judging Grand Theft Auto VI by those early images was hardly fair.
The argument is simple and, on its face, persuasive. Leaked material showed a work in progress, official trailers showed a polished version of the same idea, and launch coverage describes a finished world that critics rewarded with a 99 on Metacritic. Yet a headline that tells readers never to doubt a studio is commentary, not a measured fact. This analysis separates what is confirmed from what is opinion, checks the leak comparison against launch numbers, and asks what it means for how fans, investors and rivals should read the next leak.
The commercial backdrop makes the comparison hard to ignore. Rockstar said Grand Theft Auto VI generated $3.79 billion in worldwide retail sales on launch day, a figure the Associated Press reported on November 21. As our explainer on why that number is retail sales and not Take-Two revenue shows, the accounting matters when you read the headline. The leak story and the sales story now sit side by side, and readers are asking whether the doubters were simply wrong.

GameRant’s piece is short, roughly 1,600 words including page furniture, and it carries no data tables. Its core claim is that early leaks gave a misleading picture of Grand Theft Auto VI. The writer says the leaked material made it hard to tell which version of the game people were looking at, and whether the lighting, rendering and upscaling of the final product were switched on. Those images looked underwhelming to many viewers, with limited environmental detail and a visual style short of the photorealism fans expected, or of a clear jump from Red Dead Redemption 2.
The second half of the argument concerns the living world. GameRant says Rockstar stayed tight-lipped about crowds, activities and how the environment reacts to the player, so a handful of leaked images left room for worry about stalled innovation. The outlet then says the finished game answered that worry with a long list of things to do and people to meet. In its words, Rockstar let the finished game speak for itself.
The article is less triumphant than its headline. The same writer concedes that skepticism about Rockstar is understandable. GTA Online launched with bugs and connectivity problems, Red Dead Redemption 2 had PC trouble, and GameRant says Grand Theft Auto VI’s performance is far from top notch even on the best consoles available. The piece closes by recommending that readers stay optimistically reserved and wait for the multiplayer mode before judging it. That caveat matters, because it shows even the “never doubt” argument is hedged by its own author.
The 2022 leak shaped how fans read every later image of the game. The verified fact sheet for this story confirms only the basics: early footage and screenshots associated with a 2022 leak were later compared against official material. It does not confirm which build the footage came from, which systems were active, or how close any given scene was to the shipping product. We therefore treat any claim that the leak “accurately represents” the final game as unconfirmed.
Development builds routinely lack final lighting, final assets and final upscaling. Studios cap frame rates, strip effects and run debug overlays while engineers chase other problems. GameRant makes this point directly when it says no one outside Rockstar could tell which version produced the leaked clips. A screenshot pulled from a build like that is a snapshot of a process, not a preview of a product.
Static images also say nothing about density, behavior or pacing. How many pedestrians fill a street, how shops respond when a player walks in, and how missions chain together only show up in extended play. articles.t: 'GTA 6' on Xbox Series S: How well it runs
articles.chapeau: Here's the verdict.
articles.txt:
Reading through Reddit, there is no shortage of concerns about how well Xbox Series S will or won’t run the game. As the release neared, fans seemed confident that Rockstar Games would ensure the game was playable, but opinions varied widely on what graphical sacrifices would be required for it to run, including reduced crowd density and scaled-back visuals.
How much time did I spend sweating the idea of crowd density? Too much. Did I ever think about it or care about it until Redditors said it’ll likely be less on the Series S? Not at all.
And yet, while it filled me with regret for not buying a PS5 last Black Friday before the price hikes arrived, it did not stop me from buying GTA 6 on Xbox Series S, debating whether or not to resist the pull off the New Zealand timezone trick to play it early, and preparing to explore Leonida.
And now, having played GTA 6 for a few hours, I can tell you everything you need to know about how it runs and how it feels.
I won’t keep you waiting: GTA 6 runs smooth as butter on Xbox Series S. There were no stutters, no lag or other slowdowns that pulled me out of the gameplay.
During a prologue that introduced me to protagonists Jason and Lucia, I quickly experienced a variety of locations in daytime and nighttime, as well as rainy weather. After that, I was able to play around Leonida and check out all the basic things that might catch your attention as you play: how the weather looks, flying down the road in a car through busy streets, random tasks around Jason's home.
In addition to moving quickly through various areas, I also took a moment to slow down. I watched a sunset by the water, went for a swim surrounded by fish, and observed how the environment affected Jason. Nothing slowed down, glitched out, or made me think anything other than I was playing a AAA game.
What I can’t tell you right now is how much better GTA 6 is or isn’t on PS5 or any of the higher-end consoles. We’re in the process of comparing the Xbox Series S version to the PS5 Pro version as we speak.
Rockstar has explicitly said the game will run best on PS5 consoles, with faster load times and technology that may improve resolution. The PS5 Pro version will also include ray tracing, making the lighting even more eye-catching. But both games will still be locked at 30 frames per second, according to Rockstar. The game developer did not say if any other sacrifices had to be made to get it to run on the Xbox Series S.
Regardless, what I can tell you is there is a good game waiting for you to play on Xbox Series S. If you don’t have the funds to upgrade your console, do not let comparison be the thief of joy.
GTA 6 is a generational moment in gaming and a cultural moment much larger than any game launch I’ve ever seen. The game is fun, the music is a vibe, and the world is immersive without feeling like a chore. I can't imagine waiting to play this if they have the means to do so right now.

Why GTA 6's Overhauled Wanted System is the Game's Best Feature | Man of Many
articles.chapeau: GTA 6's overhauled wanted system is the best part of the new release and is a huge upgrade for the franchise.
articles.txt:
Every product is carefully selected by our editors and experts. If you buy from a link, we may earn a commission. Learn more. For more information on how we test products, click here .
Few things are more synonymous with GTA than getting a six-star Wanted Level and turning an entire city into your personal warzone. We’ve all been there. One minute, you’re casually cruising through Los Santos or Vice City, and the next, you’ve got half the police department, a helicopter and what feels like the entire military chasing you down the motorway.
Honestly? That’s always been part of the magic of the franchise. Whenever you can’t be bothered to do a mission, there is always an epic police hunt right around the corner to keep you entertained.
I’ve spent countless hours playing through Rockstar’s Grand Theft Auto games , and if there’s one thing I’ve learned, it’s that getting into trouble is often just as entertaining as completing the actual missions. Some of my fondest memories of San Andreas are heading straight for the train tracks to see how long I can survive against increasingly ridiculous odds; the Wanted system has always been one of my favourite parts of the franchise.
Rockstar has fundamentally rethought what it means to be a criminal in GTA 6. With an overhauled Wanted system, a new Heat mechanic, witness identification, and consequences that extend beyond simply losing the police, GTA 6 makes criminal activity feel more deliberate than ever.
Not the enormous Leonida map or the impressive graphics. Not even Jason and Lucia’s Bonnie-and-Clyde-inspired relationship. Rather, the thrill of thinking before you act and the satisfaction of pulling off a robbery without ever getting noticed.
Image: Rockstar Games How Does The New GTA 6 Wanted System Work? First things first, GTA 6 brings back the iconic six-star Wanted Level after GTA 5 reduced the maximum to five stars. A small detail, but a great return to the franchise’s roots nonetheless.
However, the number of stars is only a small part of what’s changed.
In previous GTA games, committing a crime could attract immediate police attention, sometimes regardless of whether anyone had actually witnessed it. GTA 6 introduces a more sophisticated approach, where witnesses and security systems play a key role in determining whether authorities become aware of your actions.
That might sound like a relatively small adjustment, but it completely changes how players approach criminal activity.
For example, robbing a store isn’t necessarily as simple as pointing a gun at the cashier and collecting your money. You need to consider who’s watching, whether CCTV cameras have captured your appearance, and how you’ll leave without giving the police an easy description.
Rather than simply tracking your Wanted Level, the police can gather identifying information about Jason and Lucia. This includes their physical appearance, clothing, weapons, getaway vehicles and whether they’re travelling together.
These identifying details are represented by icons beneath the Wanted stars, effectively showing players what information the authorities have gathered. In other words, the police aren’t just looking for somebody who committed a crime. They’re building a profile of the people responsible. And that makes escaping considerably more complicated.
One of my favourite things about older GTA games was just how ridiculous the Wanted system could become.
I’ve lost count of the number of times I’ve deliberately pushed my Wanted Level as high as possible, only to find myself dodging police cruisers, shooting helicopters out of the sky and desperately trying to survive against increasingly ridiculous odds.
GTA has always encouraged that kind of chaos. But there’s also something hilarious about how easily you could escape the consequences thanks to the iconic Pay ‘n’ Spray system. Get yourself into trouble, find a garage, drive inside and emerge with a fresh coat of paint. Suddenly, the authorities have apparently forgotten everything you’ve done and what you look like, even if they literally watched you drive into the mechanic.
Of course, there were other ways to escape. Breaking line of sight, finding a secluded alleyway or simply driving fast enough could be enough to shake the police. I loved it. There’s a reason players have spent decades deliberately trying to reach the highest possible Wanted Level. Despite all this, GTA 6’s approach feels considerably more interesting.

articles.t: How to Enable Auto-Drive In GTA 6 (& Why You Should
articles.chapeau: Auto drive is a new feature in Grand Theft Auto and we show you not only how to use, but why you should.
articles.txt:
By Mark O’Callaghan Published Nov 22, 2026, 8:35 PM EST Mark is the lead gaming critic for CBR who passionately shares his reviews of the latest video games. He's been hooked on gaming since getting a Nintendo GameCube and Super Mario Sunshine. It took him a while to decide what he wanted to do, but soon, he realized that talking about pop culture and gaming could be a career. After graduating from the College of Saint Rose, he's been writing since and sharing his passion for those inclined to read. When Mark is not writing, he's playing games, reading comics, watching the latest TV show, and hanging out with his dog, Kara (named after Supergirl). He also hosted the KeenGamer podcast at one point and has appeared on other pop culture podcasts like The Brazilian Dragon. With his reviews, Mark conveys whether you should buy the game or not with concise points and analysis. Sign in to your CBR account Grand Theft Auto is back with some of the best gameplay and graphics the franchise has seen so far. GTA 6 takes players across the massive map of Leonida, where they can drive, waterski, fly, and travel in plenty of other ways.
One new feature in GTA 6 that players should know about is auto-drive. While anyone who played Red Dead Redemption 2 will be familiar with a similar mechanic, auto-drive works a little differently here. It offers several benefits that not only improve the experience but can almost function like a built-in cheat code.
Image via Rockstar Games To enable auto-drive in GTA 6 , open the map and set a waypoint anywhere. It could be a side activity, the start of a mission, an objective, or another destination. Once players get into a vehicle, they’ll need to hold down on the D-pad until the prompt to enable Cinematic Drive appears.
As the name implies, the vehicle will then drive to the destination while following traffic laws. Players can also adjust the speed between three different levels. There are two different options for auto-drive: "restricted" and "unrestricted." When restricted is enabled, the vehicle will always stick to standard routes, but with unrestricted on, auto-drive can be used even when the car is off-road.
To toggle between these options, go into the game's settings and select "gameplay." From there, you can find auto-drive under the accessibility section. Players have the option to set auto-drive to either restricted or unrestricted. The unrestricted setting can lead to collisions or other vehicle damage, so players should employ it with caution.
Along with the auto-drive setting, GTA 6 has other options that will let players customize their driving experience, such as an option to lower vehicle damage with the reduced vehicle damage setting, which is also found under the accessibility menu. Even with these options, some players may find auto-drive boring, but there are plenty of benefits to using it.
Auto drive Image via Rockstar Games The most important aspect of GTA 6' s auto-drive is that it’s free compared to using the RideMe app. Unless players want to pay extra for instant fast travel, there’s little reason to use the app. Auto-drive can easily take players to unexplored areas of the map, helping them uncover even more content.
While using auto-drive, players can also enjoy the incredible views of Leonida for free. Some of the game’s scenery and realistic details are even more impressive when viewed through Cinematic Drive. What’s even more special is when Jason and Lucia are in the car together. When players control the vehicle, they get the standard GTA driving view.
With auto-drive, however, these interactions play out more like cutscenes. The small details in their facial reactions show why Rockstar Games is hailed as one of the best developers in the industry. GTA 6 is a serious game of the year contender, and experimenting with features like auto-drive will let players appreciate just how impressive it really is.

articles.txt:
Looking for all the Kitty Litter Lab locations? Find them all here with this official GTA 6 guide . After completing the Here, Kitty Kitty mission in Chapter 3 , Tyrone and his partner Dook send Jason on the hunt to destroy 20 Kitty Litter labs . He'll pay you for every lab you destroy. This is tracked under the Robberies index in the map, with every lab located somewhere in Vice City. Tyrone will occasionally send you locations of labs.
Have you destroyed all the labs? Keep track of them here. As always, this guide serves as to suggest ways to complete the mission. You may approach labs and destroy them in the way that best suits you.
After completing Here, Kitty Kitty, Dook will eventually text Jason the location of the first Kitty Litter lab target. This will be in northern Vice City, just a few blocks north of Tyrone – it will be marked on your map. Once you complete this lab, you are free to complete the remaining 20 right after.
Follow the waypoint to the lab and approach from the northwest side. The entire area will be shaded in purple, indicating that you will need to find the location of the lab yourself – these are how all of these will be. As you approach from the northwest, you’ll see a green gate that you can go through. Once through the gate, take an immediate right.
Looking forward, you’ll see a white van on your left. Make a left after passing the van.
Right next to the van after turning left, you’ll see a green house with purple smoke with some men out front. This is the synthetic lab you’re looking for.
You can either shoot the guys to gain entry or knock them out. Shooting them leads the cops to your location faster as someone nearby will report the shooting. Once inside the house, you’ll see the lab, shoot one of the glass beakers to start a fire and then leave the trailer before it explodes.
Once the lab explodes, leave the area and Jason will call Dook to let him know that the lab is destroyed. Once this happens, you can periodically talk to Tyrone to ask him where more locations are. But at this point, you can find all Kitty Litter labs in GTAVI.
Approach the search area from the south to see the laundry van parked near the entrance to the apartment plaza. Go through the entrance.
Once through the entrance, look left to spot the purple cans in front of a white door on the second floor. The lab will be inside that door, in apartment 103 .
When entering from the north, you’ll see Peterson’s Autoshop. Run in front of it and circle around to the left, which will put you on the right side of the shop.
To the right of the front of the shop is the laundry van. You’ll need to enter the van and move it forward to reveal the door to the lab.
Once the van is pulled forward, it’ll reveal a shutter. Open the shutter to enter the lab.
When approaching from the north, you’ll see an open gate with the laundry van parked to the left. On the right side of the parking lot, climb the stairs to get to the second floor.
Once upstairs, enter apartment 5, which is the middle grey door. The lab will be inside.
When approaching West La Perle trailer from the east, go through the double-wide gate to enter the trailer park. The last trailer on the right is the lab.
Just be aware that as you approach the trailer, there will be a man on the couch out front as well as two women talking. As you approach, they will open fire, so you’ll need to take them out. There will be one more person inside the trailer, but they typically will run away. Enter the trailer and destroy the lab.
When approaching from the southeast, you’ll see a road entrance into the trailer park. Enter through that entrance and turn left at the cross section.
A way down on the left will be a green-trim trailer with purple smoke emitting from the top. That's the lab.
Once you’re at the trailer, you’ll see the laundry van in front of the door to the trailer. Enter the trailer to destroy the lab
When approaching from the northeast, you’ll see the laundry van parked to the right, next to a fence. Go to the van to enter the alley.
With the laundry van to your left, look ahead to see a man standing in front of a gate. Take the man out and go through the gate. There will be a couple more lab members that will open fire. Take them out and enter the lab, which is to the left of the kitty image.
When approaching from the north, you’ll see the laundry van next to a large gate. Enter the gate and approach the shutter. Where the lab is located.

Nobody can give one exact count for GTA 6’s vehicles. The roster runs to several hundred vehicles across roughly 17 classes. The gtabase database lists 319, and the fan-run GTA Wiki lists about 360, a figure that includes entries seen only in leaks. Below, the vehicles are grouped by class. Real cars are named where a source makes the link, and unconfirmed entries are flagged.
Rockstar has not released a full vehicle list. The names here come from three places: the gtabase vehicle database, the GTA Wiki vehicle page (which flags leak-only entries), and Rockstar’s own trailers and press screenshots. When a name rests on just one of these, that is noted.
The most accurate answer is somewhere from 300 to 360. According to gtabase’s own page, its database covers 319 vehicles. The GTA Wiki page has roughly 360 entries, though it states that it includes content that only showed up in leaks. Counts of 250, 298 and more than 500 circulate on other sites, but several of them have unclear sources, so they are left out here.
Both databases divide the roster into new vehicles and ones returning from earlier GTA games. The returning group is long, taking in the Banshee, Infernus Classic, Dominator, Buffalo, Sultan, Granger, Burrito, Seashark and Maverick.
The classes below follow the GTA Wiki’s sorting. Every example is a name the wiki does not flag as leak-only, which means it comes from trailers, screenshots, artwork or Rockstar posts.
Separate guides go class by class in more detail, covering sports cars, supercars, muscle cars, SUVs and trucks, motorcycles, boats, aircraft, off-road vehicles and emergency vehicles. You’ll find them linked at the bottom of this page.
As in previous games, every car carries a fictional manufacturer, and the databases match each maker to a real brand. gtabase maps Albany to Cadillac, Declasse to Chevrolet, Grotti to Ferrari, Vapid to Ford, Benefactor to Mercedes and Ubermacht to BMW. Pegassi draws on Lamborghini, Ducati and Piaggio.
For many individual models, gtabase also names the real car behind them. These matches are the fan database’s interpretation, and Rockstar has not stated them.
gtabase outlines three ways. The first is theft: carjack an occupied car or steal a parked one. Older cars give way to a slim jim or a broken window, while high-end cars need a key cloner. The second is buying, either through the in-game internet or at dealerships on the map. The third is recovery, where a destroyed car can be brought back for a fee through the Scooter Bros app and an abandoned one can be reclaimed from the police impound.
A stolen car is only temporary until you register it, and a fence has to remove its tracker first. Each step is covered in the guides on the key cloner, personal cars and the impound.
Some names sit in the gtabase database yet carry a leak-only mark on the GTA Wiki, among them the Bestia GTS, Neo, Locust, Omnis and Injection. Count those as likely, not certain. Neither database publishes prices, top speeds or exact spawn points. Older pre-launch lists on other sites also mix in real brand names such as Audi or Ford models, and those do not appear in Rockstar’s materials.
Last checked 18 November 2026. This page is updated as launch-era information comes in.
There is no exact figure. gtabase lists 319 vehicles, and the GTA Wiki lists about 360 counting leak-only entries, so the true total falls within that range.
No. It uses fictional makers such as Grotti, Vapid and Declasse. The databases link them to real brands, for example Grotti to Ferrari and Vapid to Ford, but Rockstar has not confirmed those links.
Helicopters appear in Rockstar’s trailers and screenshots, and several models are listed. The aircraft guide covers which aircraft can be flown at launch, and some plane details are still unconfirmed.
Yes. Both databases list motorcycles, including the Enduro, Cliffhanger and Sanchez, and boats, including the Seashark jet ski, Squalo and Marquis.
Per Rockstar art and the Gfinity guide, the Ultimate Edition includes the Cheetah (1995), Dominator Buggy (’67), Ganado, Dinka Enduro, Crest Kayak and Shitzu Squalo. Sources do not agree on the exact count.
Neither has been published yet. gtabase says Rockstar has not released fence prices, and the databases have no verified speed figures.

GTA 6 Is Getting Review Bombed in Zelda vs. GTA Troll War
articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto is getting attacked by anti-woke culture warriors and even Zelda fans
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 may be the highest-rated game of all time on Metacritic , and may have earned a record-breaking $3.79 billion on launch day , but that doesn't mean Rockstar Games' new blockbuster can't have its haters. Multiple groups have descended on GTA 6 's Metacritic page to attack the game for its perceived shortcomings, much of that criticism is based on culture war nonsense.
But some of GTA 6 's detractors are targeting the game for another reason: for slighting The Legend of Zelda.
Image: Rockstar Games GTA 6 made its debut on Metacritic with a 99 Metascore , based on more than 150 critics reviews. That feat nudged the previous best game of all time, at least going by Metacritic score averages, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time , down to No. 2 on the review aggregator website. That has led some Legend of Zelda supporters to review bomb Grand Theft Auto 6 on Metacritic, and some GTA 6 supporters to do the same to Zelda. Now, both camps are in a pointless war to lower the other franchise's user review score.
Over the past few days, GTA and Zelda fans have been trading barbs and slinging "0" user review scores at their perceived rivals. As of Sunday, Nov. 22, Grand Theft Auto 6 's user review score on Metacritic has dipped to 5.6, indicating "mixed or average" reviews from players. In response, the original Ocarina of Time and its Nintendo Switch 2 remake have also been review bombed (though their user scores are in the mid-8s as of Sunday).
Unsurprisingly, the discourse around this pointless feud has not been particularly intelligent. Each camp is simply trying to drive down its rivals’ user score, with supporters writing the bare minimum in their user "reviews" — often with plenty of typos.
Even poor Soulcalibur , the 1999 fighting game released on Dreamcast, is catching strays amid the fighting. Some GTA 6 supporters are now wading into Soulcalibur 's user reviews, slamming Bandai Namco's weapons-based fighter for no good reason beyond its ranking as the third-best game of all time according to Metacritic's algorithm.
Image: Nintendo Grand Theft Auto 6 's detractors aren't just misguided Zelda fans. Unsurprisingly, a contingent of GTA fans are attacking the game for its perceived "wokeness" amid more legitimate concerns about performance. "30 FPS, Concole Exclusive, Restricted freedom and uninteresting characters are a no go for a 13 year development cycle," reads one recent negative review of GTA 6 . Much of the feedback, however, seems to focus on having a female co-lead character and game mechanics that ask players to be considerate toward her .
"In GTA6 you need to do chores, pick up an abusive girl from prison and then do more chores. Boring characters, boring missions and 30fps cap. I would have rather burned that $100 than giving it to the woke garbage R* has become," reads one scathing review.
"15 years for this dissapointing cuck simulator. Rip rockstar. You were my childhood," reads another. "Game is straight woke trash," another troll says.
The tenor of GTA 6 's negative reviews isn't much different from the trollish feedback infesting reviews of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, surprisingly. "THEY MADE LINK A CUCK IN THIS GAME!!!!! ALWAYS DOING WHAT HIS FEMALE FAIRY NAVI TELLS HIM WHAT TO DO!!!! CRITICS PROVE ONCE AGAIN THEY’VE BEEN BOUGHT OFF!!!!!" reads one of the many negative reviews to invoke cuck simulator language.
While this kind of petty squabbling is par for the course in internet discourse, especially in the video game sphere, at least fans of both The Legend of Zelda and Grand Theft Auto can take comfort in knowing that both franchises have great games to enjoy in 2026. And that, if you're reading this, you're likely not spending your time fighting in the Metacritic comments.

articles.t: How Long Is Chapter 3 in GTA 6? All Missables and Mission List
articles.chapeau: Find out how long Chapter 3 is in GTA 6, with the full mission list, missable quests, vehicles, and what to do before the final mission.
articles.txt:
X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard Add Us On Google Chapter 3 of Grand Theft Auto VI finally takes Jason and Lucia to Vice City, where they begin working with several new criminal organizations. However, there are a few missable missions and rewards you should get before progressing too far into the story. Here is how long Chapter 3 is in GTA 6 , its full mission list, and everything you should do before starting the final mission.
The Cartel Heist is the final mission in Chapter 3 of GTA 6 . The mission sees Jason and Lucia working with Raul to rob the Sinfrontera National Bank in Vice City. However, before you can start the heist, you will need to complete several preparation missions throughout the chapter.
Unlike Chapter 1’s Tourist Trap mission , you won’t immediately be locked into the final sequence of events. Instead, you will spend much of Chapter 3 preparing for the bank robbery while also completing jobs for other characters. Once you’ve finished the necessary story missions and heist preparations, Raul will eventually contact you to begin The Cartel Heist.
I recommend making a manual save in a separate slot before starting the robbery. Grand Theft Auto VI doesn’t have a mission replay feature, so this is your best option if you want to return to Chapter 3 later.
Chapter 3 has several optional missions, unique weapons, and rewards that players can potentially miss. While you can return to Vice City after progressing to Chapter 4, certain events and choices will no longer be available.
Here is everything I recommend doing before finishing GTA 6 Chapter 3:
The most important mission here is Race Against Yago, as it’s one of the few optional activities in Grand Theft Auto VI that can be permanently missed. Thankfully, you don’t need it for 100% completion or trophies.
During Chapter 3, Jason and Lucia will become involved in a strange storyline surrounding a mysterious statue. This eventually leads to the Dubious Provenance mission, where you must decide whether to trust Halifax.
If you keep the statue but never follow up with Halifax, you can miss the additional quest and its rewards. For a full breakdown of the choices, check out our GTA 6 Trust Halifax or Not guide .
There are also two weapons worth looking out for during Chapter 3’s main storyline. Both can be missed if you complete their respective missions without collecting them.
I would prioritize getting both weapons during your first playthrough. Since GTA 6 doesn’t let you replay completed missions, you won’t be able to simply restart these jobs from the menu if you forget to pick them up.
Inside Boobie’s apartment safehouse, there is a secret puzzle that you can start by checking his laptop. After opening his email and looking at notes scattered around the apartment, you will discover the garage code 92665 , which can be used to unlock the Del Rio Boulevard Garage.
Inside the garage is a rare pink Pfister Vanessa’s Growler , which can only be obtained during Chapter 3. However, this vehicle is permanently missable, so make sure to collect it before completing The Cartel Heist.
Even if you know the passcode, the garage will no longer open after Chapter 3 . As a result, you’ll want to complete Boobie’s apartment puzzle and claim Vanessa’s Growler before progressing to Chapter 4.
Finally, I recommend taking some time to explore Vice City before completing The Cartel Heist. Chapter 3 introduces several new contacts and activities, many of which can be completed outside the main storyline.
This includes helping Billy, finishing Kyle’s storyline, taking on jobs for Yasmani, and progressing Yago’s street racing missions.Most of these optional activities can still be completed later in the game.
However, I’d still recommend finishing any missions you have already started before moving into Chapter 4, especially if you’re trying to see as much of the story as possible.
Chapter 3 of GTA 6 takes approximately 10 to 15 hours to complete if you focus primarily on the main storyline. However, you should expect to spend considerably longer if you want to explore Vice City, complete optional missions, and unlock the new activities introduced throughout the chapter.
Chapter 3 is also one of the longest sections of Grand Theft Auto VI . There are several major storylines happening at the same time, and you will frequently need to switch between Jason and Lucia to progress different missions.

GTA 6 Ride or Die walkthrough: Where to find the DWNPLY sneakers and get them for free | VGC
articles.chapeau: Where are the DWNPLY sneakers in GTA 6?
articles.txt:
Wondering where to find the DWNPLY sneakers and get them for free in the Ride of Die mission?
Ride or Die mission sees Jason team up with his pal Dre’Quan to pull off a high-stakes car/fancy shoes theft. Here’s how to complete the GTA 6 Ride or Die mission, including where to find the sneakers, how to get them for free and how to steal DWNPLY’s car.
This Ride or Die walkthrough is one of dozens of GTA 6 guides we’ve published since the game launched. Check them all out in our GTA 6 Guide Hub .
Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub , featuring beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more.
Ride or Die becomes available in Chapter 3 after completing Credit Check.
Around a day later, Dre’Quan will message Jason and ask him to meet outside the Jack of Hearts club in Crosstown. You can only start this mission as Jason. If you approach the mission start with Lucia, the mission will be locked out, and you’ll have to wait and come back later as just Jason.
Sit on the ledge outside and wait for Dre’Quan to appear. He’ll tell you about his plan to steal DWNPLY’s car, but in order to do that, Jason and Dre’Quan will have to get close to him. The best way to do this is to get to DWNPLY’s sneaker launch at the Eris store.
After the chat, follow him to the Eris store on the Downtown waterfront.
There are several different ways you can get the DWNPLY sneakers. One option is to find the couple pictured in the image above, that are taking a photo. Speak to them, and then eventually they’ll leave the store. After they walk far enough away, you can rob them.
If you do this, you have to make sure you weren’t spotted, and that it wasn’t reported to the police, or it will cause the mission to fail. You can also buy the sneakers for a scalper that is hanging around the shop. This costs over $1000 and is not worth it, especially when you can easily steal them.
Head up to the top floor, and look for the door in the image above. There will be an NPC in a pink dress standing near it. As long as there are no staff around (they walk around the floor in shifts, so just wait if one is close) you can walk straight through this door.
Behind the door you’ll find a staff break room. Here you can walk over to a pair of the sneakers that are sitting in a bag near a table. If you’re struggling to find them, check the image below and match it in-game.
Now that you have the sneakers, head back downstairs in the Eris store and speak to Dre’Quan, who will be waiting just beyond the entrance. Follow him upstairs towards the VIP lounge. A bouncer will initially block your way, but look at him and select the Show Shoes interaction.
Showing the DWNPLY sneakers allows Jason to enter without paying. Once inside the VIP lounge, head towards the left of the bar to find DWNPLY sitting with a group of people.Approach him and hand over the sneakers. While he’s signing them, hold the triangle interaction button to reach for his car keys.
He’ll interrupt Jason to ask who the signature is for. Answer his question, then continue holding the button until Jason successfully takes the keys.
Follow Dre’Quan downstairs and head towards the parking garage.
Use the car horn prompt to locate DWNPLY’s vehicle. Follow the sound towards the eastern side of the parking lot, where you’ll find the car in a lit VIP parking space. The parking space glows green, so you should be able to see it from far across the parking garage.
As you leave, a gang member will jump onto the bonnet. Swerve from side to side to throw him off before driving towards the Stockyard Speedshop. Alternatively, you can do what I did and take a jump at a ridiculous angle and the bodyguard will take off into space. Then, DWNPLY’s bodyguard and his gang will pursue you. Escape the red search area on your minimap before continuing to the Speedshop.
Completing Ride or Die doesn’t provide any rewards. Not even the shoes.

Cyberleak's GTA 6 Xbox Build Could Reach PC Before an Official Port - MMOs.com
articles.chapeau: Cyberleak says it is torrenting a full Xbox GTA 6 build and will drop the launcher executable on November 23, months before any official PC port.
articles.txt:
The hacker group Cyberleak says it holds a complete November 2026 Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto VI, is distributing the files by torrent, and will release the launcher executable on November 23.
In a November 19 post, Cyberleak said it had the full console build and was pushing it out immediately. "CL holds the full November 2026 build of Grand Theft Auto VI, and it is going out by torrent," the group wrote, framing the dump as a reason not to preorder the game. The launcher executable is being held on a countdown, and Cyberleak says it will hand the file over early if the group's crypto token reaches a $15 million market cap.
Grand Theft Auto VI is already out on console, and Rockstar has not announced a PC version at all. Rumors point to an official port in early 2027, which would stretch the gap to months. Obbe Vermeij, Rockstar's former technical director, has argued the company would benefit from shipping a PC port early given the rise of AI-assisted ports. If a hacker collapses that window first, the first GTA 6 experience on PC would arrive through a torrent rather than a launcher, with no support, no online mode and no guarantee the thing runs.
PC players have taken matters into their own hands before, as with the fan project that brought Need for Speed: Underground 2 back as a browser MMO 20 years after release.
Cyberleak's pitch to PC players is speed. "This community will have it emulated inside a week, running far past 30fps," the group claims. No robust Xbox Series X|S emulator exists yet, which makes that timeline doubtful. The dump is also incomplete: the security archive vx-underground says the torrent contains real GTA 6 assets but is missing the launcher .exe, and that if the file drops on the 23rd, people could be playing and modding the game on PC the same day. If the Xbox build never becomes a working port, Cyberleak says it will go after a PS5 build.
> wake up > take a shit > get out of bed > check beep boop > over 9000 DMs > "SCHMEELI, GTA VI LEAK" > ??? > sends link > torrent > ok > look inside > actual assets > huh > squint eyes > look closer > not larp huh, how about that. the cyberleek guy released the full xbox gta 6… pic.twitter.com/1MDrGI97Dy
The crypto condition is the credibility problem. Cyberleak previously used GTA 6 leaks to pump a scheme worth $250,000, so the $15 million market-cap target reads as much as a sales pitch as a countdown. The group says the November 23 release happens regardless of what its token does.
Rockstar has made no statement on the leak or on a PC version. Cyberleak says the Xbox executable drops Monday, November 23.

articles.t: GTA 6 has appeared on Steam, but it's not the PC port fans are waiting for
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 is finally out now on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, but PC gamers are still waiting for Rockstar to announce a release date for their platform. In the meantime, a fake listing for the game has appeared on Steam.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 is finally available on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, but PC players are still waiting for Rockstar to announce a release date for their platform. Interestingly, recent developments suggest that an unofficial PC port could become playable as early as next week. And amid all this, a GTA 6 listing has appeared on Steam, but it's not what you might think.
For those who missed it, the notorious leaker Cyberleek recently released a nearly complete Xbox build of GTA 6 . The leaked files are reportedly around 209GB in size, and several community developers have already started working on ways to get the game running on Windows.
However, the build is missing its main executable, which Cyberleek has promised to release on November 23. The leaker believes modders could make GTA 6 playable on PC within a week, although there's no guarantee this will happen.
While interest in a PC version continues to grow, a suspicious GTA 6 listing has now appeared on Steam. However, unlike a normal Steam listing, it doesn't feature any screenshots, developer information, or publisher details. It is also tagged as free-to-play, which clearly doesn't match Rockstar's latest release.
What's more interesting is that the listing isn't entirely new. According to SteamDB, the application was originally added to Steam nearly three years ago but remained largely inactive until recently, when it suddenly received several updates. SteamDB has also flagged the application as suspicious, warning that it could be malicious or impersonating another product. The tracking website has advised users against purchasing or downloading it, if it becomes available.

articles.t: Voiture Fast & Furious GTA 6 : où trouver la Penumbra FF (Mitsubishi Eclipse)
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 cache évidemment plein de références à dénicher, notamment à d’autres œuvres de la pop culture. Dans cet épisode, on peut même [...]
articles.txt:
GTA 6 cache évidemment plein de références à dénicher, notamment à d’autres œuvres de la pop culture. Dans cet épisode, on peut même trouver un clin d’œil à la saga Fast & Furious avec un véhicule emblématique à voler. Voici où le trouver.
Où trouver la Maibatsu Penumbra FF (Mitsubishi Eclipse de Fast & Furious) dans GTA 6 ? GTA 6 rend hommage à sa manière au regretté Paul Walker en représentant la Mitsubishi Eclipse de son personnage dans les films Fast & Furious . Pour trouver ce véhicule qui se nomme ici Maibatsu Penumbra FF (1997) , vous devrez vous préparer à le voler. Et mieux vaut au moins avoir passé le chapitre 2, ou la mission de Moses, pour disposer d’outils de crochetage et pour pouvoir ensuite conserver cette voiture si vous le souhaitez.
Une fois ces dispositions prises, rendez-vous à Vespucci Island, au cœur de Vice Dale . Une île visiblement réservée aux riches, avec de belles demeures, même si peu d’entre elles peuvent être cambriolées. Au milieu de l’île, vous trouverez une résidence ouverte avec quelques voitures garées devant.
Ce qui nous intéresse, c’est ce qui se trouve dans le garage. Enfoncez la porte puis allez vite éteindre l’alarme pour ne pas avoir les flics sur le dos. Vous trouverez alors la voiture en question, toute de vert et de bleu vêtue. Il ne vous reste plus qu’à la voler pour ensuite aller faire un tour à Vice City avec. Vous constaterez que c’est un vrai bolide de course, qui va très vite et qui tient bien la route, soit l’inverse de la voiture de départ de Jason.
Une fois la Maibatsu Penumbra FF au garage, rien ne vous empêche de filer vers Vice City à son volant. Moses, qui vous permet de la conserver, rachète aussi les autres voitures volées : tout est expliqué dans notre guide pour gagner de l’argent dans GTA 6 , le reste est dans notre guide complet de GTA 6 .

articles.t: GTA 5 Steam player counts surge in anticipation of GTA 6 PC port release date
articles.chapeau: GTA 5 is enjoying a second life as Steam player counts reflect newfound support. The Enhanced and Legacy versions are more popular now than before the GTA 6 release date. Desktop and laptop gamers are also anticipating an official PC port or version based on a leaked Xbox build.
articles.txt:
Despite historic sales of Rockstar’s new title, many PC gamers aren’t fleeing to Xbox or PS5 consoles . GTA 5 Steam player counts are spiking following the release date of its successor. Meanwhile, interest in a GTA 6 PC port has renewed after a leaked build could soon become playable.
The GTATracker site shows how the GTA 6 launch encouraged Steam users to return. Although peak concurrent player counts didn’t reach the all-time high of 360,761, they are on an upswing. Including GTA 5 Enhanced , Legacy , and Online participants, the total crossed 238,000 on November 22nd. That’s double the number from some of the busiest days earlier in the month.
ⓘ screenshot, GTATracker GTA 5 Steam player counts shown The tracker doesn’t consider individuals using the Epic Games Store or the Rockstar Games Launcher . Even more significantly, the FiveM role-playing servers remain popular among Twitch , Kick , and YouTube streamers. While most fans find the single-player saga of Lucia and Jason compelling, a multiplayer mode isn't available yet.
It’s unclear when GTA 6 Online may surface, but datamines suggest the Xbox and PS5 builds already have multiplayer code. GTA 5 loyalists on Steam are waiting for a PC version and also a follow-up to Rockstar’s online service. The company continues to support the existing option, with bonuses to celebrate the latest entry’s arrival.
New mods also boost the GTA 5 Steam player count. The tweaks keep San Andreas feeling fresh, even after completing the campaign for Michael , Franklin, and Trevor .
This audience was recently given another reason not to embrace the new console exclusive. Cyberleek returned with an Xbox build, minus the .exe file. The infamous leaker expects either an emulated solution or a playable PC alternative to be developed shortly.
Many fans likely won’t approve of a glitchy imitation of an official GTA 6 port. As for when Rockstar might accommodate them, a GamesBeat report identified Q1 2027 as a possible release date. However, that would contradict the pattern of Red Dead Redemption and previous Grand Theft Auto titles. The studio normally keeps titles locked to consoles longer.

articles.t: Sortie d'hôpital (Fin du Chapitre 1) | Soluce GTA 6
articles.chapeau: Pour cette dernière mission du Chapitre 1 de GTA 6, Lucia se rend à l’hôpital de Vice City, mais son arrivée ne passe pas inaperçu. Cette [...]
articles.txt:
Pour cette dernière mission du Chapitre 1 de GTA 6 , Lucia se rend à l’hôpital de Vice City, mais son arrivée ne passe pas inaperçu. Cette mission clôture la première étape de l’aventure en Leonida, si tant est que nos deux héros s’en sortent indemnes.
Chapitre : Chapitre 1 (Un goût de paradis) Mission : 22 sur 22 Mission précédente : Home Sweet Home Mission suivante : Y’a quoi dans le sac ? – Chapitre 2 (Le Paradis Perdu) Lieu : Hôpital de Vice City Rien ne peut être manqué Deuxième étage : Réanimation Cette dernière mission du chapitre démarre automatiquement après « Home Sweet Home ». Lucia se rend à l’hôpital de Vice City pour retrouver Jason. Dès que vous rentrez dans l’hôpital, prenez vers la gauche et empruntez les escaliers pour atteindre le deuxième étage . Vous pouvez demander votre chemin à la réceptionniste de l’étage avant de suivre le couloir avec la ligne de couleur rose au sol. Cherchez la chambre 203 pour retrouver Jason.
Lucia va alors l’installer dans un fauteuil roulant afin de le faire sortir de l’hôpital, mais des hommes armés arrivent dans les couloirs et ouvrent le feu sur nos deux protagonistes. Vous prenez alors le contrôle de Jason, mal en point. Malgré ses blessures, vous pouvez utiliser une arme pour repousser les assaillants pendant que Lucia vous pousse .
Surveillez toutes les directions et surtout, prenez le temps de viser en utilisant si besoin le mode Concentration . Vous risquez de perdre plus d’une fois si vous ne contrôlez pas votre visée, surtout en présence de nombreux ennemis à la suite. Alors que Lucia cherche un véhicule pour quitter la zone, Jason se retrouve donc seul jusqu’à ce qu’un adversaire armé d’un fusil à pompe débarque. Tuez-le et récupérez son arme pour les suivants jusqu’à ce qu’un ennemi tire sur des bonbonnes de gaz à côté de vous, provoquant une explosion qui projette Jason au sol.
Rampez jusqu’à l’arme devant vous pour poursuivre et éviter qu’on vous abatte mais Lucia finira par revenir au volant d’une ambulance et percuter le dernier assaillant et ainsi reprendre votre fuite.
Enfin, à l’arrière de l’ambulance et en tant que Jason, vous devrez repousser les véhicules qui vous pourchassent, en priorisant les conducteurs et les roues des voitures pour les ralentir en provoquant des collisions entre véhicules. Continuez ainsi jusqu’à ce que la séquence prenne fin en démarrant la cinématique finale du Chapitre 1. Vous vous réveillez le lendemain matin dans un motel, avec la première mission du Chapitre 2, « Y’a quoi dans le sac ? », et un Jason mal en point.

articles.t: Can Cyberleek's leaked GTA 6 Xbox build become a PC port? Three GitHub projects are trying, without the executable
articles.chapeau: Three GitHub projects are exploring whether an unverified Xbox Series X|S build of Grand Theft Auto VI attributed to leaker Cyberleek could yield an unofficial PC port. None has booted the game without the main executable, and unresolved graphics compatibility issues mean that even Cyberleek’s promised November 23 release of the file would not guarantee playable performance.
articles.txt:
A 209 GB package that leaker Cyberleek says is the Xbox Series X|S build of Grand Theft Auto VI has circulated on torrent networks since the game launched on November 19. Community developers are already studying it in hopes of an unofficial PC port, but none of their projects has booted the game because the main executable is the one file Cyberleek has held back.
In a statement relayed by PC Gamer , Cyberleek describes the files as version 1.0.2.1 of a November 2026 build. The leaker says the executable will go out on Monday, November 23, no matter what, or immediately if its CYBERLEEK memecoin reaches a $15 million market cap. That target is half the $30 million goal the token missed in October, and PC Gamer, citing Cyberleek's site, put the coin at about $1.83 million when the statement went up. Cyberleek also made a confident prediction:
"This community will have it emulated inside a week, running far past 30fps."
None of this has been independently verified, and Rockstar has not authenticated the files. One porting project reports that Windows found signature hash mismatches in 12 of the package's DLLs, a discrepancy it cannot yet explain. Earlier fake builds trading on Cyberleek's name were also found to carry malware .
The Xbox Series X|S runs on an AMD Zen 2 CPU with the same x86-64 instruction set as a PC. That is why the GitHub project Leonida can load the game's CPU code and run it natively instead of translating it, while reimplementing the console's system software around it. Xbox 360 projects such as Liberty Recompiled, which brings the console version of GTA IV to PC, must first convert the console's PowerPC code into C++.
The graphics are a much tougher problem than the CPU code. Leonida says it has translated all 26,503 of the game's RDNA 2 shaders into SPIR-V, the format used by Vulkan, and every one passes the SPIR-V validator. Its README cautions, however, that this checks the code's structure rather than its output.
There is also a catch for Nvidia owners. In total, 21,545 of the shaders are wave64 programs built for AMD's 64-wide wavefronts, while Nvidia and Intel GPUs execute in groups of 32. Leonida emulates the wider waves on those cards, which it says is exact for compute and mesh shaders but still approximate for some vertex, pixel, and geometry shader operations.
Xbox2Windows , which calls GTA VI its "motivating case study," instead translates selected x64 code into C++ and shaders into the DXIL format used by DirectX 12. Its README is blunt: "The main executable was absent from the inspected files." So far, the project reports that 851 of the game's 12,101 pixel shaders have compiled and match controlled test output.
AnyXboxX , a prototype Xbox Series X emulator, can run code directly on the host CPU or inside the Unicorn CPU emulator in an isolated mode. Its inventory of the package found 103 of the 104 expected files, with only the main executable missing, and its shader work so far covers a Microsoft ray-tracing library shipped with the game rather than the game's own shaders. The project's research notes, citing another team's findings, add that the game's mesh shaders carry no root signatures, the tables that map shaders to their resources, and that those sit inside the missing executable.
If Cyberleek follows through on Monday, these projects will finally have an executable to work with, though booting the game and running it at playable frame rates are separate milestones. "Emulated inside a week" sets a far higher bar than anything the teams have published, and none currently claims the game gets past startup. Anyone tempted by the files should also remember that downloading them is piracy, and that unverified game packages remain a common route for malware.

articles.t: GTA 6 : tous les codes de triche sur PS5 et Xbox, et comment les débloquer
articles.chapeau: Les codes de triche sont de retour dans GTA 6, mais Rockstar a changé les règles pour les obtenir. Comment les débloquer et les activer sur PS5 et Xbox Series ? On vous explique tout, avec la liste complète.
articles.txt:
Argent à volonté , char d'assaut en plein Vice City, munitions infinies ... Depuis GTA III , les codes de triche font partie de l'ADN de la saga, et Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6 ) ne fait pas exception. Rockstar Games a pourtant changé les règles du jeu. Selon le recensement de Dexerto , le titre compte 61 codes, disponibles sur PS5 et Xbox Series , qui touchent à l'argent, aux armes, aux véhicules, à la météo et aux filtres d'image.
Contrairement aux précédents épisodes, impossible de les utiliser dès le début de l'aventure : il faut d'abord terminer l'histoire principale de Jason et Lucia , puis débloquer chaque code un par un. Voici comment faire, étape par étape.
Oubliez HESOYAM sur San Andreas ou les numéros de téléphone de GTA V , qu'on tapait dès la première heure de jeu. Ici, première étape obligatoire : boucler la quête principale. Et elle n'est pas courte : d'après PC Gamer, cité par Selectra , le menu des codes reste fermé tant que les 91 missions de l'histoire ne sont pas terminées. Une fois le générique passé, direction le menu Progression , onglet Codes de triche . Comme l'expliquent nos confrères du Journal du Geek , c'est là que s'affichent tous les codes et leurs conditions. Ceux que vous n'avez pas encore débloqués apparaissent comme indisponibles, et leur combinaison reste cachée.
Deuxième étape : remplir la condition propre à chaque code. Lancer 100 grenades , pêcher 100 poissons , voler 100 voitures de police ... Il y en a pour tous les goûts. Bonne nouvelle, toujours selon Dexerto , ces conditions peuvent être remplies avant la fin de l'histoire, et les objectifs accomplis pendant la trame principale comptent aussi. Si vous avez déjà beaucoup exploré Leonida, une partie de la liste sera donc débloquée d'office.
Quelques codes ne demandent rien d'autre que d'avoir fini le jeu, à commencer par celui qui donne 250 000 $ . Un clin d'œil savoureux quand on sait que GTA V n'a jamais proposé de code pour l'argent.
Une fois le code débloqué, la manipulation est simple. Sur PS5 , d'après nos confrères du Journal du Geek , il faut ouvrir le téléphone avec la flèche du haut, maintenir L1 et R1 , puis taper la séquence avec la croix directionnelle. Sur Xbox Series , le même geste se fait logiquement avec LB et RB . Toutes les combinaisons n'utilisent que les flèches : elles sont donc identiques sur les deux consoles. À noter, les codes ne fonctionnent qu'en mode histoire, pas en ligne.
Avant de vous lancer, un conseil : sauvegardez . Et pour cause : activer un code désactive les sauvegardes et l'obtention des trophées et succès pour toute la session en cours. Si vous visez le platine, mieux vaut garder une partie "propre" à part. Pour revenir à une partie sans triche, quittez le jeu sans sauvegarder et relancez votre dernière sauvegarde. D'autres façons de désactiver un code pourraient exister : nous mettrons cet article à jour dès qu'elles seront confirmées.
En voici une liste non exhaustive. Notez que toutes les combinaisons ne sont pas encore connues : celles qui manquent s'affichent dans le menu une fois le code débloqué.
Le jeu propose aussi un code qui remplit toutes les munitions au maximum. Ses conditions de déblocage restent à confirmer : nous compléterons cet article dès que possible.
Vingt et un véhicules sont disponibles, du char d'assaut au flamant rose gonflable. Les combinaisons relevées pour l'instant par Dexerto et Gameblog :
Pour les autres, la combinaison s'affiche dans le menu une fois le code débloqué :
Oui. Deux codes permettent de jouer avec l'heure de la journée :
Un troisième code permet de faire défiler la météo. Sa combinaison et ses conditions de déblocage restent à confirmer : nous mettrons cet article à jour dès que possible.
C'est la grande nouveauté : 16 filtres qui transforment Vice City en film noir, en vieille VHS ou en jeu rétro. Plusieurs se débloquent en jouant avec votre partenaire.
Quand peut-on utiliser les codes de triche dans GTA 6 ? Une fois l'histoire principale terminée, et après avoir rempli la condition de chaque code.
Où voir la liste des codes ? Dans le menu Progression, onglet Codes de triche.
Comment entrer un code ? Ouvrez le téléphone (flèche du haut), maintenez L1 + R1 sur PS5 ou LB + RB sur Xbox Series, puis tapez la combinaison avec la croix directionnelle.
Les codes désactivent-ils les trophées ? Oui, ainsi que la sauvegarde, pour toute la session en cours.
Peut-on tricher en ligne ? Non, les codes ne fonctionnent qu'en mode histoire.

articles.t: Le récap tech de la semaine : GTA 6 explose les records, la cybermenace s'intensifie
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 bat tous les records, les cyberattaques se multiplient, l’IA change d’échelle et Voyager 1 franchit une distance historique.
articles.txt:
Sony détaille un peu plus la rétrocompatibilité sur sa PlayStation 5. Il sera possible de jouer à la grande majorité des jeux PlayStation 4 sur la PS5, mais tous ne seront pas compatibles.
Du 16 au 22 novembre, GTA 6 a redéfini ce que peut représenter le lancement d’un jeu vidéo, jusqu’à mobiliser une part considérable du trafic Internet français. La semaine a aussi été marquée par une série d’attaques visant des institutions publiques, de nouveaux modèles d’intelligence artificielle et plusieurs annonces rappelant que les services numériques ne sont jamais éternels. Entre Google Assistant qui prépare sa sortie, Microsoft To Do qui abandonne les particuliers, Voyager 1 qui s’éloigne toujours davantage et le CD qui revient avec du Bluetooth, la tech a une nouvelle fois avancé dans plusieurs directions à la fois.
GTA 6 transforme son lancement en phénomène d’infrastructure Rockstar peut difficilement espérer un meilleur démarrage. GTA 6 a généré 3,79 milliards de dollars de ventes au cours de ses premières 24 heures, établissant un record pour l’ensemble du secteur du divertissement. L’éditeur revendique également 32,5 millions de précommandes, après treize années d’attente depuis GTA 5.
Ces chiffres ont une traduction très concrète dans les réseaux. Avec un téléchargement dépassant les 200 Go, le trafic français a atteint des niveaux inédits chez plusieurs opérateurs. Bouygues Telecom a mesuré une hausse de 10 % par rapport à ses journées habituellement les plus chargées, avec des téléchargements représentant jusqu’à 40 % du trafic total en journée. Orange a observé environ deux fois son niveau habituel, tandis que Free avait renforcé sa bande passante avant le lancement.
Les réseaux ont tenu, mais Rockstar a dû affronter une autre forme de surcharge. Le hacker Cyberleek a diffusé une version Xbox de développement pesant 209 Go. Le torrent ne contenait pas l’exécutable principal nécessaire au lancement du jeu, mais des internautes ont déjà pu examiner des textures, fichiers audio et autres ressources.
Cette fuite ne remet pas en cause les ventes déjà réalisées, mais elle ajoute un nouvel épisode à une sortie devenue aussi importante pour la cybersécurité et les opérateurs que pour les joueurs. GTA 6 n’est plus seulement un jeu très attendu : il est désormais capable de modifier pendant quelques heures la forme du trafic Internet d’un pays entier.
Le gouvernement français a décrit une menace informatique à un niveau « grave et inédit » . Les attaques ne se limitent plus au vol de fichiers ou aux rançongiciels : elles peuvent désormais viser des installations physiques, comme l’ont montré les sabotages de systèmes frigorifiques dans plusieurs centaines de magasins.
À partir de 2027, chaque ministère devra consacrer au moins 5 % de son budget numérique à la cybersécurité, puis 10 % en 2030. Le plan prévoit également 200 millions d’euros pour soutenir la cyberdéfense, le chiffrement post-quantique et la protection des infrastructures critiques. Le gouvernement accepte même que certains nouveaux services numériques soient retardés lorsqu’ils détournent des ressources de la sécurisation des systèmes existants.
L’intelligence artificielle devient elle aussi un accélérateur d’attaque. La Commission européenne a confirmé avoir été ciblée par ARTEX, une plateforme de tests d’intrusion pilotée par de grands modèles de langage. Plusieurs applications internes ont été mises hors ligne pendant une dizaine de jours, tandis que l’enquête doit encore déterminer si certaines données ont été consultées ou récupérées.
La semaine s’est terminée avec deux nouvelles intrusions aux États-Unis. Le piratage du FBI concerne sa base nationale de renseignements criminels, tandis que le ministère de l’Agriculture a vu un système destiné aux paiements des agriculteurs être compromis. L’étendue exacte des deux attaques reste inconnue et rien ne permet d’affirmer que l’ensemble des bases concernées a été dérobé.
Le point commun entre ces affaires n’est pas une campagne unique, mais la valeur croissante des systèmes administratifs, industriels et policiers. Un attaquant ne cherche plus nécessairement une base de cartes bancaires : une application de ressources humaines, un système de paiement agricole ou un logiciel de réfrigération peuvent offrir des moyens de pression tout aussi importants.

articles.t: Ni GTA 7 ni Red Dead Redemption 3 : une fuite dévoile le prochain jeu inattendu de Rockstar
articles.chapeau: À quelques mois de la sortie de GTA 6, une vieille fuite ressurgit et affirme connaître le prochain jeu de Rockstar Games. Entre rumeur tenace et indices troublants, un retour inattendu se dessine.
articles.txt:
À quelques mois de la sortie de GTA 6, une vieille fuite ressurgit et affirme connaître le prochain jeu de Rockstar Games. Entre rumeur tenace et indices troublants, un retour inattendu se dessine.
Rockstar Games a sorti Grand Theft Auto VI depuis le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, et la communauté se projette déjà sur le prochain titre du studio. Beaucoup imaginaient un enchaînement logique avec un hypothétique GTA 7 ou un Red Dead Redemption 3 , pendant que les fans réclament toujours un Bully 2 .
Une ancienne fuite remise en lumière change pourtant le scénario : le prochain jeu de Rockstar après GTA 6 serait ni plus ni moins qu’un L.A. Noire 2 , suite inattendue du jeu d’enquête culte de 2011. De quoi relancer les fantasmes, mais aussi les doutes.
L’affaire remonte à décembre 2023, avec un post anonyme sur 4chan, ressorti le 28 septembre 2026 sur GTAForums par l’utilisateur « Shahanshah ». Ce même leaker avait livré à l’avance plusieurs détails justes sur GTA 6 (duo de protagonistes, éléments de scénario), validés depuis, ce qui donne du poids à ses propos.
Selon cette fuite, Rockstar ferait une pause après GTA 6 sur ses machines à cash que sont Grand Theft Auto et Red Dead Redemption , pour signer un retour à l’enquête policière avec un L.A. Noire 2 . Le premier épisode, développé par Team Bondi et publié par Rockstar en 2011, avait marqué avec sa technologie de capture faciale MotionScan, un 89 sur Metacritic et plus de 7,5 millions de ventes.
Important : Rockstar Games et Take-Two Interactive n’ont jamais confirmé l’existence du projet. Tous les médias sérieux classent ce L.A. Noire 2 en rumeur crédible, mais non vérifiée.
La fuite décrit un changement radical de décor : adieu Los Angeles, bonjour San Francisco . L’intrigue se déroulerait dans les années 60, au moment où sévit le tueur du Zodiaque , serial killer bien réel jamais identifié. Le joueur mènerait la traque, dossier par dossier, dans une baie embrumée idéale pour un polar noir.
Le leaker évoque aussi un énorme focus sur la capture faciale, avec l’objectif de fixer un « nouveau standard » visuel pour l’industrie, comme l’avait fait L.A. Noire en 2011. Cette techno serait au cœur des interrogatoires, toujours basés sur les micro-expressions des suspects, mais avec un réalisme largement supérieur aux modèles actuels.
Côté calendrier, le projet viserait une sortie autour de 2030, ce qui placerait L.A. Noire 2 dans la génération post- GTA 6 , probablement sur les successeurs des consoles actuelles et sur PC.
Sur le papier, plusieurs éléments rendent cette rumeur cohérente . En mars 2025, Rockstar a racheté Video Games Deluxe, studio de Brendan McNamara à l’origine de L.A. Noire: The VR Case Files , pour le renommer Rockstar Australia . Difficile de ne pas y voir un candidat idéal pour piloter un projet centré sur l’enquête et la capture faciale.
Au printemps 2026, le PDG de Take-Two, Strauss Zelnick , expliquait vouloir « faire quelque chose à l’avenir avec toutes nos licences », tout en précisant « you never know » et « rien à annoncer » à propos de L.A. Noire 2 (propos rapportés par GameSpot). Officiellement, donc, rien n’existe.
En face, un GTA 7 ou un Red Dead Redemption 3 demanderaient des cycles de production énormes alors que Rockstar Games va déjà entretenir GTA 6 et son online pendant des années. Un projet plus ciblé comme L.A. Noire 2 , vitrine narrative et technologique, apparaît ainsi comme un « entre-deux » plausible. Tant qu’aucun trailer ou communiqué ne tombe, il faudra toutefois traiter cette fuite comme ce qu’elle est : un scénario séduisant, mais spéculatif.

articles.t: Bye Bye Don (Revolver de Donnie) | Soluce GTA 6
articles.chapeau: Pour la mission  Bye Bye Don  de GTA 6, Brian charge Jason de débarrasser la caravane de Donnie à Key Lento. Il va falloir faire le ménage et [...]
articles.txt:
Pour la mission « Bye Bye Don » de GTA 6 , Brian charge Jason de débarrasser la caravane de Donnie à Key Lento. Il va falloir faire le ménage et s’assurer qu’aucun élément compromettant ne reste derrière eux, en profitant pour se servir au passage.
Chapitre : Chapitre 1 (Un goût de paradis) Mission : 18 sur 22 Mission précédente : Bourbier Mission suivante : Recalibrage Lieu : Caravane de Donnie à Key Lento Peut être manqué : Revolver H&L .38 de Donnie, variante unique Les conséquences de vos actes Après les événements de la mission « Bourbier », Brian vous demande de faire disparaître toutes les traces qui pourraient relier le regrété Donnie à ses opérations. Commencez par rejoindre la caravane de Donnie à Key Lento . Entrez à l’intérieur et dirigez-vous vers la chambre pour récupérer son sac, posé sur le lit, ainsi que plusieurs effets personnels, pour faire croire à un simple départ de la région et non à une mort mystérieuse. Pour trouver les 6 bons objets, vous pouvez utiliser le mode Concentration de Jason et mettre la main sur :
Vous trouverez même une paire de lunettes unique sur une étagère.
Une fois les affaires rassemblées, sortez de la caravane pour tomber sur trois militaires rencontrés lors de la soirée au Rusty Anchor et qui souhaitent terminer ce que vous aviez commencé l’autre soir. A votre guise, vous pouvez les affronter ou simplement prendre la voiture de Donnie à droite et fuir vers le nord pour éviter l’affrontement .
La prochaine étape consistera à faire disparaître définitivement la voiture . Vous pouvez par exemple trouver un coin tranquille et utiliser le bidon d’essence présent dans le coffre pour asperger le véhicule et y mettre le feu, ou conduire directement la voiture dans l’océan pour la laisser couler.
Attention toutefois avant de détruire le véhicule, vous devez impérativement son coffre. Vous y trouverez le revolver H&L .38 de Donnie, une variante d’arme unique qui peut être définitivement manquée si vous détruisez la voiture sans l’avoir récupérée. L’arme sera ensuite ajoutée définitivement à votre arsenal des Ammu-Nations. Une fois le véhicule détruit, la mission se termine et laisse place à la prochaine, le dernière avant le point de non-retour de ce premier chapitre, « Recalibrage ».
Vous pouvez aussi retrouver l’ensemble de nos conseils et guides dans notre guide complet de GTA 6 .
